issues.body: print_census labels every no-area, no-needs:area issue as `with no board state at all`, but the added tests intentionally include issues carrying priority, role, kind, and needs:user labels. The workflow summary repeats the same claim. The census classification itself is correct; the human-facing description overstates what was measured.
issues.fix_hint: Rename the category to the precise measured condition, such as `without needs:area`, `unparked`, or `with neither area:* nor needs:area`, and make the corresponding wording in .github/workflows/triage-area.yml equally precise.
issues.title: Unparked issues are inaccurately described as having no board state

verdict.summary: The census implementation is read-only, fail-closed on truncation, deterministic, and correctly separates no-area issues by needs:area status. The workflow keeps it in a separate reporting step, and the tests exercise the real CLI/list path plus the cross-file output-prefix contract. One wording defect should be cleaned up, but it does not undermine the census or create a security issue.
